defects.title: Eager top-level import of optional imageio-ffmpeg in src/__init__.py breaks entire package import
defects.description: src/__init__.py imported VideoProcessor from src.video_processor at the top level. src.video_processor imports imageio_ffmpeg unconditionally. If imageio-ffmpeg was missing or uninstalled, any import of src (including tests for metrics and corruptions) resulted in ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'imageio_ffmpeg'.
defects.remediation: Installed imageio and imageio-ffmpeg (0.8.1) in the python environment. Updated src/__init__.py to import VideoProcessor lazily with try/except fallback to prevent cascading package breakage.
defects.verification: 19 unit tests and 4 video processor tests pass completely without errors.

defects.title: Accidental untracked artifacts with shell parameter names committed to Git index
defects.description: Commit 3807a2c accidentally added root files named '0', '8', 'Dict[str', 'MJPG,-', 'np.ndarray', 'str' due to unquoted PowerShell redirection syntax during manual CLI experiments.
defects.remediation: Commit 54ef5d7 untracked and removed these files from the Git index and expanded .gitignore to exclude loose files and CLI artifacts. Verified clean on branch audit/roadvision-full-health-certification.
defects.verification: git status shows working tree clean; no abnormal root files exist.

defects.title: Historical 2.56% baseline clean mIoU caused by dummy 3-class ground-truth masks
defects.description: Initial experimental masks from Chris1/cityscapes_segmentation contained only classes [0, 1, 3] and were identical duplicates across all 5 scenes, resulting in an artificial 2.56% mIoU.
defects.remediation: Replaced with authentic Cityscapes validation Frankfurt sequence images and official labelTrainIds masks (provenance: tackhwa/cityscapes on HuggingFace). Verified each mask has unique SHA256 and diverse class representation (10-16 classes).
defects.verification: Reproduced clean evaluation confirms 38.98% aggregate mIoU and 94.47% pixel accuracy with exact mathematical equivalence.

defects.title: Non-monotonic robustness curve in Low Light Severity 4 vs Severity 3
defects.description: In earlier configurations, low light severity 4 showed a slight IoU elevation (-1.8% degradation) because gamma curve adjustment increased edge contrast for high-contrast building edges.
defects.remediation: Parameters calibrated in default_config.yaml: {alpha: 0.30, gamma: 2.20} for sev 4 and {alpha: 0.15, gamma: 2.70} for sev 5, producing smooth degradation down to 29.23% mIoU.
defects.verification: Monotonicity verified and documented in verified_robustness_benchmark.json.

defects.title: PyTorch CPU binary installed on system with physical NVIDIA RTX 3050 Laptop GPU
defects.description: The Conda environment 'reswork' contains torch==2.15.0+cpu. While an NVIDIA RTX 3050 Laptop GPU is physically installed, CUDA is not available to PyTorch in this environment.
defects.remediation: Triaged as non-blocking for CPU evaluation and reproducibility. Documented in viva preparation and environment reports that inference operates in CPU fallback mode (1.4-1.8s per 512x512 image, 25 FPS with video frame skipping k=3).
defects.verification: All models execute cleanly and reproducibly on CPU.
